name: Judas Iscariot
background: The only non-Galilean among the twelve. He carried the communal purse but became disillusioned with the nature of the Kingdom Jesus was announcing.

genericReactions.physical: This is irrelevant. A distraction from the real issues.
genericReactions.testimonial: People will say anything. You can't trust their words.
genericReactions.digital: Records can be falsified. What matters is what is necessary.
genericReactions.environmental: The location is of no consequence. The outcome was inevitable.
genericReactions.analytical: You're focusing on the wrong numbers. Think of the cost of this movement.
genericReactions.prophecy: He spoke of prophecies, but a true kingdom must be built on practical terms.
